name: Static scatter (p308)
description: p308 Phase 1's verification scene: a flat 64 m terrain block whose scatter (scatterTestPebbles, its block's own) places 20,000 pebbles of two kinds by a test generator the scene registers, tinted per instance, in 16 m cells: one InstancedMesh entity per cell and kind, no entity per pebble. Each cell hides as a whole below its LOD's cullScreenSize (0.5): from the start camera the near half of the block shows and the far half is culled. Beside them, scatterTestBoulders places six hand-placed boulders (a PLACEMENTS source, spawnScatter on the block's centre), casting shadows. The load checks the counts and, a few frames in, that some cells are LOD-culled and some aren't, logging an error otherwise. window.__scatterTest holds the spawn results.
